text: Create custom objects with 20+ field types and build relationships between objects

text: Create custom many-to-many relations between any objects

quote: Custom objects get the same first-class treatment as built-in ones — including API endpoints, views, permissions, and workflow triggers.

text: Workflows can chain record operations, emails, HTTP requests, code, branches, iterators, AI agents, delays, and forms

Send Slack alerts when a deal reaches a certain stage

text: Filter which emails get imported by date range or sender

text: Developers can build full-featured apps on top of Twenty with custom UI, server-side logic, and deep integrations, publishable publicly or privately

text: AI chatbot answers natural-language questions about CRM data, queries records, and summarizes information
quote: Ask questions about your data in natural language. The AI chatbot can query your CRM records, summarize information, and help you find what you're looking for without building complex filters.

text: AI agents are restricted to objects/fields the user's role permits, keeping sensitive data protected
quote: Agents can only access objects and fields that the user (or role) has permission to view. Sensitive data stays protected even when AI is involved.

text: Dashboards support configurable chart type, data source, filters, aggregation, and grouping
quote: You can configure: Chart type... Data source... Filters... Aggregation... Grouping

text: Dashboards are workspace-level, shared with the whole team, with resizable grid-layout widgets
quote: Dashboards are workspace-level — everyone on your team can see them. Arrange widgets in a grid layout and resize them.

text: New custom objects automatically get REST and GraphQL endpoints identical to built-in objects
quote: when you add a custom object (say Invoice), it immediately gets REST and GraphQL endpoints identical to built-in objects like Company or Person.

text: Metadata API lets you programmatically create/modify/delete objects, fields, and relations
quote: Metadata API — /rest/metadata/ and /metadata/ Schema management: create/modify/delete objects, fields, and relations. This is how you programmatically change your data model.

text: API keys can be scoped to a specific role to limit access
quote: Keys can be scoped to a specific role under Settings → Members → Roles → Assignment tab to limit what they can access.

text: REST and GraphQL support batching up to 60 records per request, including GraphQL batch upsert
quote: Both REST and GraphQL support batching up to 60 records per request — create, update, or delete. GraphQL also supports batch upsert

text: Install latest stable Twenty via a single install script command
quote: Install the latest stable version of Twenty with a single command: bash <(curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/twentyhq/twenty/main/packages/twenty-docker/scripts/install.sh)

quote: Map your columns to Twenty fields ... Review errors (highlighted in yellow) and fix them, directly editing in the UI

quote: Export your workspace data for backups, reporting, or migration. ... Export limits: Up to 20,000 records per export.

text: Scaffold a new app with the official Twenty CLI, defining objects, fields, and views as code
quote: Scaffold a new app with the Twenty CLI: npx create-twenty-app my-app ... Define objects, fields, and views as code

quote: npx twenty app:publish --private
